methods.name: find_prefilter
methods.summary: Run this finder on the given haystack as a prefilter.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new prefilter that reports possible locations where the given needle matches.

methods.name: pair
methods.summary: Returns the pair of offsets (into the needle) used to check as a predicate before confirming whether a needle exists at a particular position.

methods.name: with_pair
methods.summary: Create a new prefilter using the pair given.

items.name: Pair
items.summary: A pair of byte offsets into a needle to use as a predicate.

methods.name: index1
methods.summary: Returns the first offset of the pair.

methods.name: index2
methods.summary: Returns the second offset of the pair.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new pair of offsets from the given needle.

methods.name: with_indices
methods.signature: fn with_indices(needle: &[u8], index1: u8, index2: u8) -> Option<Pair>
methods.summary: Create a new pair using the offsets given for the needle given.

methods.name: with_ranker
methods.signature: fn with_ranker<R: HeuristicFrequencyRank>(needle: &[u8], ranker: R) -> Option<Pair>
methods.summary: Create a new pair of offsets from the given needle and ranker.

items.name: HeuristicFrequencyRank
items.summary: This trait allows the user to customize the heuristic used to determine the relative frequency of a given byte in the dataset being searched.

methods.name: rank
methods.summary: Return the heuristic frequency rank of the given byte. A lower rank means the byte is believed to occur less frequently in the haystack.
